block.description: The confstack provider resolves layered, hierarchical YAML configuration into a single merged output.

config.description: The fully resolved configuration map (secrets are redacted).

flat_config.description: Flattened view of config with separator-delimited keys. All values are converted to strings.

flat_separator.description: Separator used when flattening nested keys into flat_config. Default: ".".

layers.description: Ordered list of YAML file paths (or glob patterns, including ** for recursive matching) to load and merge. Prefix an entry with literal: to force exact path matching for filenames containing glob metacharacters. Index 0 is lowest priority; last entry is highest. Glob patterns are expanded alphabetically at their position.

loaded_layers.description: Ordered list of layer paths that were successfully loaded.

on_missing_layer.description: How to handle a layer file that does not exist. One of: "error" (default), "warn", "skip".

secret_paths.description: List of flat paths (dot-delimited) that contain secret values.

secrets.description: Sensitive variables for Go template {{ secret "KEY" }} injection.

sensitive_config.description: The fully resolved configuration map with secrets in plaintext.

variables.description: Variables for Go template {{ var "KEY" }} injection.

block.description: Merges an ordered list of YAML layer files into a single configuration map. Last layer wins.
